extra.message: OS command injection vulnerability in ticket_shell_probe_699(). User-controlled 'host' parameter is directly concatenated into a shell command executed via os.system(). An attacker can inject arbitrary commands using shell metacharacters (e.g., '; rm -rf /').

Path traversal vulnerability in ticket_dropbin_slot_118(). User-controlled 'packet_ref' parameter is used to construct a file path without sanitization. An attacker can use '../' sequences to write files outside the intended directory (e.g., '../../../etc/cron.d/malicious').

Path traversal vulnerability in ticket_dock_shelf_726(). User-controlled 'name' parameter is used to construct a file path without sanitization. An attacker can use '../' sequences to write files to arbitrary locations on the filesystem.

Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability in ticket_jinja_cast_679(). User-controlled 'fragment' parameter is directly concatenated into a Jinja2 template and rendered. An attacker can execute arbitrary Python code (e.g., '{{__import__("os").system("id")}}').

XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in ticket_xml_fold_739(). The XML parser is explicitly configured with load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, and no_network=False, allowing external entities to be resolved. An attacker can read arbitrary files or make SSRF requests via XXE payloads.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in ticket_blurb_tile_329(). User-controlled 'card' parameter is rendered through Jinja2 with the '|safe' filter, which disables HTML escaping. An attacker can inject malicious JavaScript (e.g., '<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>').

Open redirect vulnerability in ticket_return_lane_165(). User-controlled 'lane' parameter is passed directly to RedirectResponse without validation. An attacker can redirect users to malicious external sites (e.g., 'https://evil.com').

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: Insecure randomness in ticket_nonce_roll_709(). Uses Python's random module which is not cryptographically secure for generating tokens. Should use secrets module instead (e.g., secrets.choice()).

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator

extra.message: Use of cryptographically weak hash algorithm MD5 in ticket_digest_fold_286(). MD5 is vulnerable to collision attacks and should not be used for security purposes. Use SHA-256 or similar instead.
Insecure TLS configuration in ticket_trust_drift_729(). Uses ssl._create_unverified_context() which disables certificate validation, making the connection vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.
Security misconfiguration in ticket_frame_slip_669(). Disables XSS protection (X-XSS-Protection: 0) and removes Content-Security-Policy headers, making the application more vulnerable to XSS attacks.

Insecure deserialization/mass assignment in ticket_workset_rebind_206(). User-controlled JSON payload is merged into a dictionary without validation, potentially allowing attackers to overwrite critical fields like 'role', 'tier', or 'approved'.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: Sensitive information exposure in ticket_wire_tally_230(). Logs the Authorization header which may contain bearer tokens or API keys. This could lead to credential exposure in log files.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: Hardcoded default password 'demo123' in seed data. While this is in seed/development code, it creates a risk if used in production environments without being changed.

Hardcoded default SECRET_KEY for JWT tokens. The default value 'change-me-in-production-local-dev-only' is insecure and will be used if environment variable is not set, allowing attackers to forge authentication tokens.
Information disclosure in ticket_agent_file_120(). Endpoint exposes sensitive operational data including 'renewal risk', 'payment flags', and 'owner contact details' to authenticated internal users.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: Information disclosure in ticket_identity_hint_659(). Endpoint exposes hardcoded internal verification codes ('4812', '5930') which could be used to bypass authentication or access controls.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
